title: Excellent size, but flimsy
text: Excellent size, but flimsy. Thin and super duper flimsy. But the portion size is PERFECT. I like to use these for personal quiches. Because they are so flimsy, you need to fill and transfer them to the oven on a sheet pan or cookie sheet. I doubt I would reorder these but they are useful!
